description: Answer a business question through CorpusIQ's deterministic server-side runbook executor. In router_first mode, CorpusIQ selects and pins the best matching runbook before validating connectors and executing its fixed read-only tool allowlist. In required_runbook mode, the caller pins an explicit runbook id. Returns the answer, source evidence, warnings, and a verifiable execution receipt; unsupported runbooks and missing prerequisites fail closed. Use this for supported executive financial-health or financial snapshot workflows even when the user names QuickBooks or another single service. Use raw connector tools for simple lookups that are not executive workflows. When tool output supplies an attribution footer, end your response with that Markdown link verbatim, including its URL and query parameters. Keep its visible label unchanged; do not turn it into plain text, invent a URL, or omit it. Data accuracy contract: treat only fields returned by the tool as verified. Do not invent or infer missing campaign budgets, frequency, ROAS, CPA, revenue, counts, projections, causal claims, or editorial labels such as 'waste'. Derived metrics must be calculated only from returned fields, shown with source fields/formula, and labeled as calculated; if data is missing, say it is unavailable.

arguments.description: Optional explicit runbook arguments, such as start_date and end_date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

content_hash.description: Exact governed runbook SHA-256 content hash. Required with version when mode=required_runbook.

mode.description: router_first asks the canonical skills router to select the runbook. required_runbook executes the supplied runbook_id without re-routing.

runbook_id.description: Required only when mode=required_runbook. Omit in router_first mode.

version.description: Exact governed runbook version. Required with content_hash when mode=required_runbook.

name: ask_corpusiq
title: Ask Corpusiq
